title: Were any bybit_2 perps open at 2026-11-05T16:00Z? (decides whether 'no 16:00Z settlement' is right)
note: Open question from BYBIT2-FUNDING-SETTLEMENT-READ. Txn log has rows to 16:20Z but no 16:00Z SETTLEMENT for bybit_2. Check trade_journal trades for account bybit_2 with opened_at <= 16:00Z < closed_at (diag journal?table=trades) and positions at that time. If one was open on a rostered symbol and no settlement booked, the venue read is wrong; if none was open, closed as correct. 2026-11-06 ANSWERED: no bybit_2 perp was open at 2026-11-05T16:00Z. Population: diag journal?table=trades limit=200 (all accounts, 2026-10-25..2026-11-06T00:09Z), 13 bybit_2 rows, none backtest. ETHUSDT id 6881 closed 2026-11-05T15:01:54Z (so ETH settled at 08:00Z, matching the venue); SOLUSDT id 6884 closed 2026-11-04T19:51Z; BTCUSDT id 6927 opened 16:04:42Z, AFTER the settlement. So 'no 16:00Z settlement' is correct. Caveat: journal-based; a position that never reached the journal would not show, and no venue position-history read was made.
